enumeration_evidence.facts: All 15,662 direct Upgrade rows in the acquired public XML export were parsed and independently enumerated. No pagination: this covers the acquired export, not every state or planning process.

acquisition.scope: Entire acquired PJM public projectCostUpgrades.xml export; only explicitly selected NY/NJ/PA/DE/MD/DC physical transmission upgrade rows admitted. Other states, withheld locations and unreviewed eligible projects excluded/deferred.

enumeration_evidence.access_review: Public-marked NYPSC docket document; original PDF bytes acquired and markings checked. Register web-text capture is research only.
enumeration_evidence.facts: Clay is the southern terminal of the Lighthouse Hill–Clay #7 line within the overall rebuild. The public project description identifies National Grid, 115 kV, and the Town of Clay in Onondaga County. The GIS identifies a substation in that town and county with non-inferred 115/345 kV values.

enumeration_evidence.access_review: Public-marked NYPSC docket document; original PDF bytes acquired and markings checked. Register web-text capture is research only.
enumeration_evidence.facts: The public description reconstructs paired 115 kV lines in Monroe County and explicitly extends Segment 5 to Pannell Station. The GIS identifies Pannell as a substation in the same county, in the Fairport/Perinton area. Its 115 kV minimum voltage is marked inferred, so it is not independent measured-voltage evidence.

enumeration_evidence.facts: The glossary identifies existing Oakdale in the Town of Union, Broome County, and defines proposed Line 961 between South Owego and Oakdale. The GIS Oakdale point in Johnson City, Broome County supports the existing facility, not the new yard footprint.

coverage_notes: Scope NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD and DC. VA/WV remain F39. Preserve all previously accepted New England projects and other producer summaries.
Counts represent native construction upgrades/cases, not distinct facilities, project programs or map positions; shared sites and component IDs remain explicit.
PJM XML acquisition is complete for the pinned 15,662-row artifact. Publication is a bounded selected cohort, not complete PJM or state coverage; 5,749 initially eligible rows included deferred work.
PJM 80 target rows explicitly withholding Location as CEII were excluded without geocoding; 17 cross-assignment rows deferred; 574 missing-state and 9,242 out-of-assignment rows excluded.
Current statuses are retained as reported; most selected PJM records are historical in-service upgrades. Active queue-related network upgrades are proposed, never inferred to be under construction.

Reference points are historical: NOAA 2017 coastal subset (processed 2018), maximum intended scale 1:80000, unknown numerical uncertainty. It includes taps; confirmed facility identity was separately reviewed.
NY uses five original public case-description documents with bounded-partial acquisition. Current construction status and service date stay unknown; September2025 register web text is research only.
New York Clay and STAR East component scope remains insufficient; no center implied for either. Partial endpoints do not trace routes or locate every ancillary project component.

DC has no approved point in this cohort. Inland PA and NY coverage is sparse because coastal/345kV references are incomplete. No comparable prior project-register vintage was acquired; source status timestamps are not construction event dates.
PJM authenticated system-map geometry, restrictive PSEG MPRP map content, route centroids and name-only asset matches were excluded.
No /time UI change; typed source-backed events are exported through the existing optional project_events field.

projects.description: The glossary identifies existing Oakdale in the Town of Union, Broome County, and defines proposed Line 961 between South Owego and Oakdale. It expressly defines proposed Oakdale as the existing station after expansion under a separate project. The GIS Oakdale point in Johnson City, Broome County supports the existing facility, not the new yard footprint. STAR East includes Line 961, portions of Lines 940/937, a temporary bypass and distribution underbuild. Oakdale is a Line 961 endpoint only; it does not locate all work. GIS ownership and the lower 115 kV voltage are unknown. The historical station point does not establish the new termination position.

projects.description: The public project description expressly proposes a new 4.5-mile, 138 kV cable, initially operated at 69 kV, between the existing Southampton and Deerfield substations in the Town/Village of Southampton, Suffolk County. The NOAA Southampton point has the same place name and 69 kV minimum/maximum values. Deerfield remains unlocated. The marshalling-yard address is neither a substation nor a line endpoint and is excluded. The docket lists an October 2025 order after the September 2025 register; status remains a historical observation until that order is reviewed.
